description: Source code for a YAML processing utility that handles YAML documents, includes, and merging, with support for URL and file includes, using libfyaml and libcurl.

methods.name: ut_kvp_createInstance
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new instance of the YAML processing context.

methods.name: ut_kvp_destroyInstance
methods.description: Destroys and frees the YAML processing instance.

methods.name: ut_kvp_open
methods.description: Opens and loads a YAML document from a file into the instance, handling includes and merging.

methods.name: ut_kvp_openMemory
methods.description: Loads a YAML document from memory buffer into the instance, handling includes and merging.

methods.name: ut_kvp_close
methods.description: Closes and frees resources associated with the instance.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getData
methods.description: Serializes the internal YAML document to a string.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getField
methods.description: Retrieves a string value for a given key from the YAML document.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getBoolField
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean value for a given key.

methods.name: getUIntField
methods.description: Helper to retrieve an unsigned long field with range checking.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getUInt8Field
methods.description: Retrieves an 8-bit unsigned integer field.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getUInt16Field
methods.description: Retrieves a 16-bit unsigned integer field.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getUInt32Field
methods.description: Retrieves a 32-bit unsigned integer field.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getUInt64Field
methods.description: Retrieves a 64-bit unsigned integer field.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getFloatField
methods.description: Retrieves a float value for a given key.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getDoubleField
methods.description: Retrieves a double value for a given key.

methods.name: ut_kvp_fieldPresent
methods.description: Checks if a key is present in the YAML document.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getStringField
methods.description: Retrieves a string value for a given key.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getListCount
methods.description: Counts items in a sequence at a given key.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getDataBytes
methods.description: Retrieves binary data (bytes) from a scalar node, parsing comma-separated values.

methods.name: validateInstance
methods.description: Validates the instance handle and returns internal structure.

methods.name: str_to_bool
methods.description: Converts string 'true'/'false' to boolean.

methods.name: convert_dot_to_slash
methods.description: Converts dot notation keys to slash notation.

methods.name: write_memory_callback
methods.description: Callback for libcurl to write downloaded data into memory.

methods.name: process_node_copy
methods.description: Recursively copies YAML nodes, processing includes and merging.

methods.name: merge_nodes
methods.description: Merges include nodes into main nodes.

methods.name: process_include
methods.description: Handles URL and file includes, with recursion limit.

methods.name: find_pattern_from_buffer
methods.description: Searches for a byte pattern in a buffer.
